Stable release · v0.5.0

Install or upgrade.

Use the same commands for a fresh installation or an upgrade. Run the Controller command and the command for your chosen console; an existing installation is upgraded in place. These commands are pinned to v0.5.0 so the Controller and console use the same stable release.

There is no separate upgrade command. To update VirtualGlove, rerun the same Controller and console commands shown below.
Before you begin: close every running game. Confirm a physical controller already works on the console. LaunchBox users must also close LaunchBox, Big Box, and RetroArch and open PowerShell as Administrator.

1. Install the Controller

Arduino UNO Q

Connect as the `arduino` user. The first line is important because an UNO Q terminal can open in a read-only folder.

cd /home/arduino
curl -fLO https://github.com/mathan416/VirtualGlove/releases/download/v0.5.0/install-uno-q.sh
bash install-uno-q.sh --version v0.5.0

2. Install one console

RetroPie

Run as the normal RetroPie login user, without starting a root shell.

cd "$HOME"
curl -fLO https://github.com/mathan416/VirtualGlove/releases/download/v0.5.0/install-retropie.sh
bash install-retropie.sh --version v0.5.0

Recalbox 10.x

Connect over SSH as `root`; do not add `sudo`.

cd /recalbox/share/system
curl -fLO https://github.com/mathan416/VirtualGlove/releases/download/v0.5.0/install-recalbox.sh
bash install-recalbox.sh --version v0.5.0

Batocera 38 or newer

Connect over SSH as `root`; do not add `sudo`.

cd /userdata/system
curl -fLO https://github.com/mathan416/VirtualGlove/releases/download/v0.5.0/install-batocera.sh
bash install-batocera.sh --version v0.5.0

LaunchBox on 64-bit Windows

Run in an Administrator PowerShell window using the Windows account that runs LaunchBox. Change the example `D:` paths to your real locations.

$destination = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\VirtualGlove-LaunchBox"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/mathan416/VirtualGlove/releases/download/v0.5.0/VirtualGlove-LaunchBox.zip" -OutFile "$destination.zip"
Expand-Archive "$destination.zip" -DestinationPath $destination -Force
Set-Location "$destination\VirtualGlove"
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\launchbox\install-launchbox.ps1 `
  -LaunchBoxRoot "D:\LaunchBox" `
  -RetroArchRoot "D:\LaunchBox\Emulators\RetroArch" `
  -ControllerHost "virtualglove.local"

Fresh installation checklist

  1. Open the Dashboard address printed by the Controller installer.
  2. In Setup, choose the platform, save its hostname or IP address, and check the address.
  3. Pair with the recommended one-time code and verify the Matrix identity.
  4. Select a player and use Centre hand.
  5. Start the Controller and test an ordinary registered NES game with VirtualGlove and the physical controller.
  6. Test game exit and, when installed, native Super Glove Ball. Reboot both devices and repeat the checks.

Supported upgrade

Upgrade v0.4.2 to v0.5.0.

The installers preserve players, calibration, tuning, dead zones, pairing, camera choices, game registrations, controller assignments, ROMs, saves, and installed native cores.

  1. Close games and frontends.
  2. Rerun the same Controller and console commands shown above.
  3. Keep the backup paths printed by both installers.
  4. Reboot and confirm pairing, players, settings, and Controller Router assignments remain.
  5. Test physical controls, VirtualGlove, the exit hotkey, and native Super Glove Ball where installed.
Stable installs: the full guide also contains unversioned commands that deliberately select GitHub’s latest stable release.
